questions.question: When exiting your vehicle, you must keep ____ in contact with the vehicle at all times.

options.text: One point
Four points
Three points
Two points

questions.correctAnswerText: Three points
questions.explanation: When exiting your vehicle during the basic vehicle control skills test, face the vehicle and keep three points of contact at all times. If your vehicle is a bus, hold the handrail. Exiting incorrectly may cause you to fail the basic control skills test.

questions.question: When parallel parking on the driver's side, you should:

options.text: Pass the parking space while backing, then pull forward into it.
Pull forward past the parking space, then back into it.
Pull forward into the parking space without passing it first.
Back into the parking space without passing it first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull forward past the parking space, then back into it.
questions.explanation: Drive past the parking space on your left. Then back into it while moving the rear of your vehicle close to the rear of the space. Your vehicle must be completely within the boundaries of the space.

questions.question: During a basic vehicle control skills test, your vehicle's final position should be:

options.text: In the general area described by the examiner.
In the exact position described by the examiner.
Within three feet of the position described by the examiner.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the exact position described by the examiner.
questions.explanation: End each exercise with your vehicle in the exact position the examiner described. Not completing an exercise exactly as described can result in failure of the basic control skills test.

questions.question: If you must back up at a student pick-up point, you should:

options.text: Back up before the students board the bus.
Let the students board the bus, then back up.
Let half the students board, then back up toward the rest.
Tell students to wait, then back toward the stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let the students board the bus, then back up.
questions.explanation: Pick up all students before backing up the school bus. Watch carefully for latecomers when backing up.

questions.question: Before evacuating a bus due to a hazard, a driver should:

options.text: Ask the students if they want to leave.
Tell the dispatcher what is happening.
Take time to decide if evacuation is necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Tell the dispatcher what is happening.
questions.explanation: If there is time, contact your dispatcher before evacuating the bus. Explain the situation to them. The decision to evacuate must be made quickly.

questions.question: When parallel parking on the driver's side, you should:

options.text: Pull forward directly into the parking space.
Back up past the parking space, then pull forward into it.
Pull forward past the parking space, then back into it.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull forward past the parking space, then back into it.
questions.explanation: Drive past the parking space on your left. Then back into it while moving the rear of your vehicle close to the rear of the space. Your vehicle must be completely within the boundaries of the space.

questions.question: During the vehicle inspection test, you must be able to do all of the following, except:

options.text: Show where the power steering fluid dipstick is located.
Check the power steering fluid level.
Ensure the power steering fluid level is above the full mark.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ensure the power steering fluid level is above the full mark.
questions.explanation: During the pre-trip vehicle inspection test, show where the power steering fluid dipstick or sight glass is located. Check that the power steering fluid level is within a safe operating range.

questions.question: If your bus has a manual transmission, you should never ____ while crossing railroad tracks.

options.text: Change gears
Use the brakes
Look both ways
Listen to flaggers

questions.correctAnswerText: Change gears
questions.explanation: Before crossing railroad tracks, make sure no trains are coming from any direction. Never shift gears while crossing railroad tracks.

questions.question: During the driving test, the examiner will score you on:

options.text: Your attitude.
How fast you reach your destination.
Your general driving behavior.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your general driving behavior.
questions.explanation: The examiner will score you on specific driving maneuvers and your general driving behavior during the on-road driving test.

questions.question: If your vehicle has a cargo lift, you should check that:

options.text: The lift is loosely attached.
The lift is not leaking.
The lift is fully extended.
The lift is the proper color.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lift is not leaking.
questions.explanation: Check the cargo lift for leaks, damage, or missing parts. The lift must be fully retracted and locked securely.

questions.question: During the basic vehicle control skills test:

options.text: Points are taken away for each pull-up.
A driver can do three pull-ups for each maneuver.
A pull-up only counts if the driver gets out of the vehicle before pulling up.
Only too many pull-ups will be counted as errors.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only too many pull-ups will be counted as errors.
questions.explanation: During the basic vehicle control skills test, one pull-up is allowed. However, too many pull-ups will count as errors.

questions.question: After students get off at school, a driver should:

options.text: Not worry about where the students go.
Leave after the students enter the school building.
Walk through the bus to check for sleeping students.

questions.correctAnswerText: Walk through the bus to check for sleeping students.
questions.explanation: After students get off at school, a school bus driver should walk through the bus to check for sleeping students, students hiding, and items left behind.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT acceptable emergency equipment?

options.text: Three red reflective triangles
Six fuses
Three liquid burning flares
Four yellow squares

questions.correctAnswerText: Four yellow squares
questions.explanation: During the vehicle inspection test, you need to show emergency equipment. This includes spare fuses, three red reflective triangles or six fuses or three liquid burning flares, and a working fire extinguisher.

questions.question: During the skills test, if you need to stop before making a turn, you should:

options.text: Skid to a stop.
Stop after the stop line to see better.
Let your vehicle roll.
Keep the front wheels pointed straight ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep the front wheels pointed straight ahead.
questions.explanation: If you must stop before turning during the driving skills test, make a smooth stop behind any stop line, crosswalk, or stop sign. Keep your front wheels pointed straight ahead and do not let your vehicle roll. Stop where you can still see the rear tires of the vehicle in front of you.

questions.question: Students should board a school bus:

options.text: In a single-file line.
Two at a time.
In the largest group possible.
Any way they want. It does not matter.

questions.correctAnswerText: In a single-file line.
questions.explanation: Students should board a school bus slowly in a single-file line while holding the handrails.

questions.question: When stopping to pick up students, park at least 10 feet away because:

options.text: You can see all their movements clearly.
It will be hard to get any closer.
Students need to walk for exercise.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can see all their movements clearly.
questions.explanation: When picking up passengers, park at least 10 feet away from students. This is safest because it makes students walk to the bus, so you can watch their movements.

questions.question: Before evacuating a bus because of a hazard, a driver should:

options.text: Ask the students if they want to leave.
Tell the dispatcher about the hazard and decide what to do.
Tell students to panic.
Have students open all windows.

questions.correctAnswerText: Tell the dispatcher about the hazard and decide what to do.
questions.explanation: In most emergencies, students are safest if they stay on the bus. If there is time, call your dispatcher to explain the emergency before deciding to evacuate.

questions.question: A post-trip inspection should include all of the following, EXCEPT:

options.text: Looking for items left on the bus.
Checking for sleeping students.
Opening windows.

questions.correctAnswerText: Opening windows.
questions.explanation: After finishing a trip, a school bus driver should check for sleeping students, belongings left on the bus, open windows or doors, mechanical problems, and damage.

questions.question: A passive railroad crossing:

options.text: Has a control device.
Does not have any control devices.
Should be avoided.

questions.correctAnswerText: Does not have any control devices.
questions.explanation: Passive railroad crossings have no traffic control devices. The driver decides whether it is safe to cross.

questions.question: If a railroad crossing gate does not go back up after a train passes, you should:

options.text: Drive around the gate.
Wait for another vehicle to cross first to see if it is safe.
Call your dispatcher.

questions.correctAnswerText: Call your dispatcher.
questions.explanation: If a gate does not go back up after a train passes, call your dispatcher. Do not drive around the lowered gate.
